title: End Times and Eschatology Doctrine
short_answer: Eschatology is the biblical teaching about the last days, including the return of Christ, resurrection, judgment, and the new heaven and earth.
summary: The Bible teaches that history will culminate in the return of Jesus Christ. The dead will be raised, all people will face judgment, and God will establish a new heaven and a new earth.
major_points: God will create a new heaven and earth
